citations.title: AGV traffic at pedestrian crossings (synthetic plant SOP)
citations.text: Every AGV route that crosses X-WEST or X-EAST must slow to 0.5 m/s or less from one cell before the crossing until it has left it, and sound the horn. Body carriers are not exempt.

citations.title: Powered industrial trucks.
citations.text: (4) The driver shall be required to slow down and sound the horn at cross aisles and other locations where vision is obstructed. If the load being carried obstructs forward view, the driver shall be required to travel with the load trailing.

citations.title: Stalled or faulted AGV (synthetic plant SOP)
citations.text: Fence the stalled AGV with a one-cell geofence. Only a person with the agv_reset skill may approach it. Other AGVs must keep two cells away and re-route; a replacement AGV takes over the kit run.

gate_reasons: routine ACT: critic and dry-run passed; you can override

agents.name: reflex
agents.role: Geofences the incident and stops or re-routes AGVs at once (rules only, under 100 ms)

agents.name: monitor
agents.role: Classifies the alarm as real or sensor noise from thresholds and Bosch vibration evidence

agents.name: candidates
agents.role: Ranks qualified workers and healthy AGVs from the Meterless World Model (one Zetaris query)

agents.name: planner
agents.role: Nemotron (deep lane) chooses among the candidates and cites the governing clauses

agents.name: critic
agents.role: Checks the plan against OSHA-based safety rules and cites the exact clause for each violation

agents.name: dryrun
agents.role: Simulates the plan for 60 s headless (A* with a reservation table) and checks collisions and ETA

agents.name: restraint
agents.role: Decides ACT, VERIFY, SAFE_HOLD, ESCALATE or DO_NOTHING from confidence and cost

agents.name: executor
agents.role: Dispatches the agents in the simulator

agents.name: verifier
agents.role: Checks that the world changed as predicted and triggers a re-plan if not
